mathematics.assertion_tested: Positive-square lapse Schur reduction and necessary finite-gradient scalar stiffness for the constructed smooth carrier.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact real algebra and SymPy real positive symbolic calculus; Lean real algebra.
mathematics.conventions: Velocity Lagrangian A(v+Hpsi)^2+B(u-Cpsi)^2+Epsi^2; K is its reduced Hessian. Smooth carrier p=rho0(exp(mz)-1)/(2m), m=1+(Ac-1)/(2(1+y²)^(1/4)),y=Y/Yd,z=ln(X/X0).

bounds.kinetic: All A,B,E>0; H,C real; nonzero velocity pair.
bounds.spatial: One exact local point Ac9,y=sqrt15,z1/3,rho0=Yd=1; derivative identity general positive variables.
